title: Florida Woman Can’t Remember Killing Her Boyfriend
description:
Bodycam footage shows the unfolding of a tragic incident in Key West, Florida, where police responded to a chaotic scene: A man suffering from a suspected gunshot wound and bleeding profusely, held by his frantic girlfriend. Detectives delve into the death of 30-year-old Tyler Nulisch, quickly identifying his girlfriend, Brittany Holbrook, 33, as the prime suspect. As the investigation progresses, Brittany's story makes a shocking shift. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
